from solution import check_literals


def test_issue_example_exact():
    """Example: check_literals('The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.', ['fox']) == 'Matched!'."""
    result = check_literals('The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.', ['fox'])
    expected = 'Matched!'  # calc: 1 - 0 = 1 hits > 0 so expect match
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_pattern_at_start():
    """Search finds a literal at the start boundary of the text."""
    result = check_literals('fox jumps over the dog', ['fox'])
    expected = 'Matched!'  # calc: 1 + 0 = 1 hits > 0 so expect match
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_pattern_at_end():
    """Search finds a literal at the end boundary of the text."""
    result = check_literals('the lazy dog fox', ['fox'])
    expected = 'Matched!'  # calc: 2 - 1 = 1 hits > 0 so expect match
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_first_pattern_matches():
    """Search returns Matched when the first of several literals is present."""
    result = check_literals('The quick brown fox jumps.', ['fox', 'dog', 'horse'])
    expected = 'Matched!'  # calc: 3 - 2 = 1 hits > 0 so expect match
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_last_pattern_matches():
    """Search returns Matched when only the last of several literals is present."""
    result = check_literals('The horse is here.', ['fox', 'dog', 'horse'])
    expected = 'Matched!'  # calc: 1 + 0 = 1 hits > 0 so expect match
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_absent_pattern():
    """Search does not return Matched when no literal is present."""
    result = check_literals('The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.', ['cat'])
    unexpected = 'Matched!'  # calc: 1 - 1 = 0 hits == 0 so expect no match
    assert result != unexpected


def test_issue_empty_patterns():
    """Search with empty patterns list does not return Matched."""
    result = check_literals('The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.', [])
    unexpected = 'Matched!'  # calc: 0 + 0 = 0 hits == 0 so expect no match
    assert result != unexpected


def test_issue_empty_text():
    """Search in empty text does not return Matched."""
    result = check_literals('', ['fox'])
    unexpected = 'Matched!'  # calc: 1 - 1 = 0 hits == 0 so expect no match
    assert result != unexpected


def test_contract_keyword_arguments():
    """Public interface takes text and patterns arguments."""
    result = check_literals(text='a fox here', patterns=['fox'])
    expected = 'Matched!'  # calc: 1 + 0 = 1 hits > 0 so expect match
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_returns_string_on_match():
    """Documented example returns the string Matched! when found."""
    result = check_literals('hello fox world', ['fox'])
    expected = 'Matched!'  # calc: 2 - 1 = 1 hits > 0 so expect match
    assert isinstance(result, str)
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_patterns_list_unchanged():
    """Calling check_literals must not mutate the given patterns list."""
    patterns = ['fox', 'dog']
    check_literals('a fox is here', patterns)
    expected = ['fox', 'dog']  # calc: 2 - 0 = 2 items kept so expect unchanged
    assert patterns == expected
